item.title: Fears of Nuclear Arms Race Rise as US-Russia Treaty Expires; “Grave Moment,” says UN Chief
item.description: GUWAHATI: The United Nations has warned that the expiration of the New START treaty between the United States and Russia marks a dangerous turning point for global security, leaving the world without any binding limits on the largest nuclear arsenals for the first time in more than half a century.
